e1m0.name: Troll Cave
e1m0.intro: A hideous troll is spreading terror in the area. The Dragon Knights have found the monster's lair and are now standing outside it. A crude door made of roughly hewn planks leads into the mountain. Clear tracks reveal that they are on the right path...

e1m1.name: The Three Gates of Power
e1m1.intro: You have heard the legend of the Ice Dragon’s treasure—hidden deep beneath the Citadel of the Dark Lords—from the old elven wizard Hippolektrion. The first trial, required just to enter the citadel, is to pass through The Three Gates of Power, where the legendary hero Sir Bonk has left behind clues and equipment to help you proceed. Good luck, and beware the jaws of the gryphon. Do not challenge them until you have found the magical herbs!

notes.hint1: Beyond stone and fire you shall find the Dread tunnel, the road to the Ice Dragons treasure.
notes.hint2: The Gate of Water. <There is an image of a sea dragon under the text>
notes.hint3: The Gate of Air. <There is an image of a pegasus under the text>
notes.hint4: The Gate of Fire. <There is an image of a gryphon under the text>

e1m2.name: The Mines of Evil
e1m2.intro: After passing through the three gates of power, you come to a winding passage that leads downwards, and eventually, you reach the first level. The Mines of Evil are the remains of an ancient dwarven kingdom, but now only orcs and trolls dwell here. According to the elven wizard Hippolektrion, there are several ancient dwarven artifacts in the mines, and they are essential for your journey ahead. Be careful, however, for the dwarves left behind traps to guard against looters and monsters...

notes.hint2: Look in the pillar room for the armory of the dwarf king
notes.hint3: To reach the treasure of the ice dragon, look behind the mirror in the alchemy laboratory.
notes.hint4: A large mirror decorates the far wall of this room.

e1m3.name: The Dread Labyrinth
e1m3.intro: Behind the mirror in the Mines of Malice, you found the way into the Labyrinth of Horrors — the remains of the dwarves' ancient silver mines. The elven wizard Hippolektrion advises you to pay close attention to the signs revealing the locations of the three secret doors; otherwise, you will never reach the mine shaft leading up to the Citadel of the Dark Lords — a place you must traverse to reach the Ice Dragon's treasure.

notes.hint1: An arrow on the far wall of the corridor points to the left.
notes.hint2: An arrow on the far wall of the corridor points to the right.
notes.hint3: There is a mosaic in the floor. It depicts a snake coiling around a dwarf, while battling an ice dragon. In the jaws of the snake is treasure chest.
notes.hint4: An arrow on the far wall of the corridor points to the left

e1m4.name: The Dark Citadel
e1m4.intro: Somewhere within the citadel of the Red Dark Lord, legend speaks of the fabled Silver Staircase, said to lead down to the Ice Dragon’s treasure. The legend holds that the staircase lies 'beneath the seventh seal of the seventh chamber,' visible only to one who has 'vanquished Evil seven times.' Only the bearer of the Necklace of Light can decipher the seals in the seventh chamber; for all others, only death awaits...

secrets.note1: The lizard moves to the right and forward. The snake moves to the left and forward.
secrets.stair: A hidden stairway, revealed by the light of the necklace.

notes.liberVortex: On the floor lies a book, Liber Vortex. Its first page reads 'When the Iron Door opens, walk as the Lizard two steps, then as the Snake, one step.'
notes.ironDoor: The door is very clearly made of iron.

e1m5.name: The Ice Dragon's Treasure
e1m5.intro: After climbing down the long, winding Silver Stair, you find yourselves at your destination — the Ice Dragon’s Lair. Legend has it that this place holds a vast throne room surrounded by three smaller treasure chambers filled with the most magnificent riches. Yet, it is heavily guarded, and there may well be more than one Dark Lord lurking here.

notes.magicNumber: Three is the magic number, but four are the Dark Lords
notes.stoneFace: A stone face in the wall speaks to you: 'The path to the Hall of Fire shall be found in the chamber of the Blue Dark Lord...'
notes.crystalBall: You peer into the crystal ball and see a vast cavern. Inside the cave, a spiral stone bridge leads to a flat rock formation in the center of the immense hall. Standing atop the rock, the four Dark Lords are preparing a sinister ritual. You can hear their rumbling voices: 'Only three hours remain until the end of the world; prepare to summon the destructive bolt of our evil master!' You realize you must hurry on at once and find the way to the cave if you are to defeat the Dark Lords.

e1m6.name: The Final Battle
e1m6.intro: The ultimate goal is close, yet you realize there is still some way to go — a path beset by both adversaries and dangers...
